title: LG ThinQ Washer Cycle Daily Event Volume
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thinq:washer
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(program_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many LG ThinQ washer cycle events land each day and how many distinct program name values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest LG ThinQ washer cycle records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct program name values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much LG ThinQ washer cycle activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
